summary: The licensed veterinarian submission. One LICENCE professional case serves a doctor whose council code is already verified (through PROMPT-005, a Phase 2 approval or the superadmin registry, whose entries are now typed as doctors) and a new doctor applying with council code and licence together. Every submission version carries the five mandatory components — council code (the verified one, unchangeable, for a verified doctor), general or specialist, an independent licence code normalised like a council code, a licence date and a licence file — plus, for a new doctor, a name and a council card; certificates with titles, website, Instagram, clinic, professional phone and services from the catalogue are optional. The licence date must be a real calendar day, not in the future by the Tehran calendar day and not before 1950. All validation happens before any file is written. Files are stored privately with the existing byte-signature check (JPG, PNG, PDF), the 10 MB ceiling, one file per main document, at most three certificates and eight files per submission, and are downloaded only through the authorized route by the owner and the association with every read audited; every stored file name in the product is now reduced to a safe label without path components, control characters or bidi overrides. Any edit after submission — while waiting for review or in answer to a correction — creates a new immutable submission version that keeps the earlier versions and their files, carries the reviewed licence file forward when no new one is attached, and bumps the case version so a decision on a version the reviewer did not see is refused; nothing is editable after a decision. The association admin approves, requests a correction or rejects, always with a reason. Approval writes the reviewed licence facts of the current version, the optional data, services and certificates onto the profile and reaches LICENSE_APPROVED_AWAITING_PAYMENT only: the tag stays UNLICENSED, replaced only to carry a newly declared scope (which also gives Phase 2 NOT_DECLARED doctors their scope), and the licensed tag waits for a verified payment. A new licence case is refused while one is awaiting payment, active, expired or suspended. The account page offers a third path for a licensed doctor, a licence form for a verified doctor, the case card with status, reasons, documents and history, the revision form while editable, and an awaiting-payment notice; the association has a queue, a detail page with every version and file, the applicant's standing, the same licence code elsewhere and the history, an overview count and a navigation entry.

A rejection writes nothing to the profile; a later approval gives a Phase 2 NOT_DECLARED doctor the GENERAL scope. The model refuses any reviewer move to ACTIVE_LICENSED_VET and any expiry while awaiting payment.

limitations: The licensed tag, the active licensed status and payment are PROMPT-008; approval here only opens that path.
Changing or renewing an approved licence is refused for now and belongs to the payment and period flow of PROMPT-008.
An unowned directory page must be claimed through PROMPT-005 before a licence can be added to it; the licence path does not claim pages.

Optional profile data (website, Instagram, clinic, phone, services, certificates) reaches the profile only through an approved licence case; a doctor without a licence has no separate editor for it yet.
Licence codes are not unique in the database; the same code on another account is shown to the reviewer.

Large multi-file submissions are bounded per file (10 MB) but also by the 12 MB server-action body limit, so several large files in one submission can be refused by the framework before the product's own checks.
The public page still shows no licence information; displaying the licensed tag is PROMPT-008 and PROMPT-014.
Deciding a submitted case performs the start of review and the decision in one step; claiming a case is PROMPT-007.
The full 161-test browser matrix was not rerun; nine suites passing through the changed code were.
Screenshots were not captured; visual fidelity of the new pages is unverified.
